C194.name: Chake Chake District
C194.documented: coastal floods, large waves, strong winds, heavy rain, and boat accidents

area.en: Chake Chake: town valleys and creek
area.sw: Chake Chake: mabonde ya mji na hori

risk.en: This area is a hilly town where storm run-off floods valley streets and the creek, and steep cuts can slide in heavy rain.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa milimani ambapo maji ya dhoruba hufurika mitaa ya mabondeni na hori, na miinuko mikali inaweza kuporomoka wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains open and build away from valley floors and steep cuts.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro wazi na kujenga mbali na sakafu za mabonde na miinuko mikali.

C195.name: Mkoani District
C195.documented: large waves, strong winds, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.sw: Mkoani: bandari na pwani ya kusini

risk.en: This area has the main ferry port and coastal villages where rough seas disrupt ferries and boats, and erosion and storm tides hit the shore.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina bandari kuu ya meli na vijiji vya pwani ambapo bahari chafu huvuruga meli na vyombo, na mmomonyoko na mawimbi makubwa hupiga ufukwe.

advice.en: For those living, fishing and travelling here, it helps to travel only on licensed vessels in safe weather, wear life jackets and build back from the shore.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kuvua na kusafiri hapa, ni vyema kusafiri kwa vyombo vyenye leseni katika hali salama ya hewa tu, kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa na kujenga mbali na ufukwe.
